sanskrit: śivaḥ śivābhir vayasvan saṃ gacchasva tanvā jātavedaḥ | ratnaṃ dadhānaḥ sumanāḥ purastād gṛhebhyas tvā varcase nir vapāmi ||
english: Auspicious, together with auspicious ones, full of vigor, unite with thy body, O Jātavedas! Bearing a jewel, well-disposed, from the front — I scatter thee forth from the houses for radiance.

sanskrit: pṛthivyāṃ gharma stabhito 'ntarikṣe divi śritaḥ | dyaur enaṃ sarvataḥ pātu yas tvā pacaty odana ||
english: On earth the hot-pot is set firm; in the atmosphere, resting upon heaven. May Heaven protect him on every side — he who cooks thee, O rice-oblation.

sanskrit: ye samudram airayan ye ca sindhuṃ ye 'ntarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyām | ye vātena sarathaṃ yānti devās tān āpnoty odanapāko atra ||
english: Those who have set the ocean in motion, and the Sindhu, those who have moved the atmosphere, the earth, and the sky — the gods who travel upon the same chariot as the wind — him, the cooker of the rice-oblation, those gods reach here.

sanskrit: ṛcā kumbhy adhihitā sāmnā pacyata odanaḥ | aṃśuṃ somasyaitaṃ manye vaiśvadevam idaṃ haviḥ ||
english: By the Ṛc-verse is the pot set upon the fire; by the Sāman-chant the rice-oblation is cooked. This I deem to be the Soma-shoot — this oblation is for all the gods, the Vaiśvadeva offering.

sanskrit: ulūkhale musale ye ca śūrpe bhūmyām ukhāyāṃ yad ivāsasañja | yā vipruṣo yāni nirṇejanāni sarvaṃ tat te brahmaṇā pūrayāmi ||
english: What has clung — in the mortar, in the pestle, in the winnowing fan, on the ground, in the cooking-pot — the drops that have splashed, the washings that have been made — all that I fill up for thee with the sacred formula.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaḥ prehi mā saṃ vikthā vy asya rajo antaram | rakṣāṃsi sarvā tīrtvā- -athā roha divaṃ tvam ||
english: Rise upward! Do not scatter; dispel the intervening murk. Crossing over all the Rākṣasas, mount thou into heaven.

sanskrit: turo no aturo bhava saṃ dhībhir dhīyatām ayam | saṃ pṛthivyā sam agninā saṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ saṃ devānām apasyayā ||
english: Swift for us, become one that knows no obstacle; let this be established together with the sacred formulas — in harmony with earth, in harmony with Agni, in harmony with the rays of the sun, in harmony with the works of the gods.

sanskrit: ājaddviṣaḥ sukṛtasya loke tṛtīye nāke adhi rocane divaḥ | mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto nv eta paścā nikṛtya mṛtyuṃ padayopanena ||
english: Scattering enemies, in the world of the well-doer, on the third vault of heaven, upon the shining firmament — blocking out the footprint of Death, they have now arrived, having cut Death down from behind by stopping his step.

sanskrit: bhūtyā mukham asi satyasya raśmir uccaiḥśloko divaṃ gaccha | uc chrayethāṃ haviṣkṛtau sādhu devān saparyatam ṛjīṣam apa lumpatam ||
english: Thou art the face of prosperity, the ray of truth; thy high-sounding fame reaches heaven. Let the two oblation-makers rise up; worship the gods well; cast away the pressings.

sanskrit: āpo devīr yajñakṛtaś citrā devīr haviṣkṛtaḥ | ekapātra odano 'gniṣṭomena saṃmitaḥ ||
english: The divine waters are the makers of the sacrifice; the resplendent goddesses are the makers of the oblation. The rice-oblation in a single vessel is measured out equal to the Agniṣṭoma rite.

sanskrit: gāyatrī havyavāḍ asi devatāgniḥ sam idhyase | sahasradhāraṃ sukṛtasya loke ghṛtapṛṣṭham amartyau ||
english: Thou art the Gāyatrī metre, the carrier of the oblation; as the deity Agni thou art fully kindled. Flowing in a thousand streams, in the world of the well-doer, with a back of clarified butter — thou art immortal.

sanskrit: tapaś ca satyaṃ caudanaṃ prāśnītāṃ parameṣṭhinau | tābhyāṃ vai svar ābhṛtaṃ tenādhipatir ucyase ||
english: Let the two Parameṣṭhins — Tapas (Austerity) and Satya (Truth) — partake of the rice-oblation. By those two, the heavenly world is brought here; therefore thou art called the overlord.

sanskrit: urugāyo *'si vāyoḥ prāṇena saṃmitaḥ | apa mṛdhrāṇi maj jahi mukṣīya duritād aham ||
english: Thou art of wide-going song, measured by the breath of Vāyu. Strike down contemptuous words from me; may I be freed from wrongdoing.

sanskrit: apa rakṣāṃsi tejasā devebhyo havyam arca tam | vyacasvān saprathā asi ||
english: Drive away the Rākṣasas with splendor; honor the oblation for the gods. Thou art all-pervading and wide-spreading.

sanskrit: uccaiḥ suparṇo divam ut patāmuṃ priyaṃ devebhyo mā kṛṇv ṛṣibhyaḥ pari dehi mām | śukraṃ śukreṇa bhakṣayā pibantu sukṛto madhu ||
english: Like the high-flying Suparṇa, fly up to heaven; make that dear one dear to the gods; deliver me to the ṛṣis. Let the pure partake of the pure; may the well-doers drink the honey.

sanskrit: dvayā devā upa no yajñam āgur yān odano juṣate yaiś ca pṛṣṭaḥ | ādityā aṅgirasaḥ svargam imaṃ prāśnantv ṛtubhir niṣadya ||
english: Two kinds of gods have come to our sacrifice — those whom the rice-oblation pleases and those by whom it is invited. Let the Ādityās and the Aṅgirasas partake of this heavenly oblation, sitting down in due season.

sanskrit: pīyūṣasya kṣīrasya sarpiṣo 'nnasyāgraṃ saṃ bharāma etat | etaṃ bhāgam ahutādbhyaḥ pra hiṇmas tan no haviḥ prati gṛhantu devā daivāḥ ||
english: The first portion of the beestings, of milk, of clarified butter, of food — this we gather together. This share we send forth to those who eat the unhurled oblation; let the divine gods accept that oblation of ours.

sanskrit: hutādo 'nye 'hutādo 'nye vaiśvadevaṃ havir ubhaye saṃ caranti | te samyañca iha mādayantām iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya matsva ||
english: Some eat the poured oblation; others eat the unpoured oblation; both together move about the Vaiśvadeva sacrificial offering. Let them, going in harmony, rejoice here; find delight in nourishment and strength for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: memā bhavo mā śarvo vadhīd gā mā vatsān klomaśvayo vidan naḥ | ye jātā ye ca garbheṣv antar ariṣṭā agne stanam ā rabhantām ||
english: Let neither Bhava nor Śarva smite these cattle; let no rough-maned disease seize our calves. Those already born and those still within the womb — unharmed, O Agni, let them take hold of the teat.

sanskrit: imā gāvo vijāvatīḥ prajāvatī strīṣu saṃmanaso bhavantu | āsu bhūmāny api pṛñcantu devā āsāṃ vatsān āyuṣā medasā saṃ sṛjāmi ||
english: These cattle, bringing forth, fruitful — let them be of one mind with the women. May the gods mingle abundance into them; their calves I unite with life-force and fat.

sanskrit: pra vīyantāṃ striyo gāvo viṣṇur yonim anu kalpayāti | pratigṛhṇatīr ṛṣabhasya reta ukṣānaḍvāṃś carati vāsitām anu ||
english: May the women and the cows conceive; may Viṣṇu fashion the womb aright. Receiving the seed of the bull, the impetuous draught-bull moves after the cow in heat.

sanskrit: prayatam agraṃ na hinasti kiṃ cana yathākāmaṃ kṛṇuta somyaṃ madhu | sādhu yajñam ahutādo nayantu rāyaspoṣā yajamānāṃ sacantām ||
english: The offered first-portion injures nothing at all; make the Soma-honey according to your wish. Let those who eat the unhurled oblation lead the sacrifice well; may increase of wealth attend the sacrificer.

sanskrit: ni te padāṃ pṛthivī yantu sindhava ud oṣadhayo jihatāṃ preratām irāḥ | parjanyasya maruta udadhiṃ sānv ā hata bhadraṃ sasyaṃ pacyatāṃ modatāṃ jagat ||
english: Let the rivers enter into thy footprints, O Earth; let the plants shoot up; let the refreshments be spurred on. Strike the ocean to its ridge, O Maruts of Parjanya; let the auspicious grain ripen; let the world rejoice.

sanskrit: sapta ṛṣayaḥ sapta sadāṃsy eṣāṃ daśa kṣipo aśvinoḥ pañca vājāḥ | prāṇo vyāno mana ākūtir vāg devī devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānatī ||
english: The seven Ṛṣis, seven are their seats, ten are the finger-like ladles of the Aśvins, five are the prizes of the course. May the breath, the diffused breath, the mind, the intention, and the divine Speech — knowing it all — carry the oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: ye ca dṛṣṭā ye cādṛṣṭāḥ krimayaḥ kikṛśāś ca ye | teṣāṃ śirāṃsy asinā chinadmy athāsāṃ vatsān āyuṣā medasā saṃ sṛjāmi ||
english: Those worms that are visible and those that are invisible, and those that are lean — the heads of all these I cut off with a sword; and then their calves I unite with life-force and fat.
